label: Bible Study
prompt: Man that is born of a woman is of few days, and full of _____.
verse: Man that is born of a woman is of few days, and full of trouble.
note: Job's sober math on the human condition — short on days, long on trouble.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye _____.
verse: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.
note: Let God's peace rule in your heart, Paul says — and, as a fine finishing touch, be thankful.

label: Sunday School
prompt: The elder unto the elect _____ and her children, whom I love in the truth; and not I only, but also all they that have known the truth;
verse: The elder unto the elect lady and her children, whom I love in the truth; and not I only, but also all they that have known the truth;
note: John addresses this little letter to 'the elect lady and her children' — perhaps a woman, perhaps a whole church.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Fear none of those things which thou shalt suffer: behold, the devil shall cast some of you into prison, that ye may be tried; and ye shall have tribulation ten days: be thou _____ unto death, and I will give thee a crown of life.
verse: Fear none of those things which thou shalt suffer: behold, the devil shall cast some of you into prison, that ye may be tried; and ye shall have tribulation ten days: be thou faithful unto death, and I will give thee a crown of life.
note: To persecuted, poor Smyrna, Jesus gives no rebuke at all — only courage and the promise of a crown.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: My son, if sinners _____ thee, consent thou not.
verse: My son, if sinners entice thee, consent thou not.
note: Solomon's first fatherly warning is short and sweet: if sinners 'entice' thee, consent thou not.
